thread:
maria: FYI I updated the postmortem doc with the initial action items and a new 'testing & drills' board. Need clear owners for regression suite, prompt sets, load tests, and chaos drills. Proposed owners: ben (regression suite), dmitri (load tests), eva (prompt sets), sam (chaos drills). Can folks confirm timelines or nominate alternates?

ben: I can take the regression suite. Plan: ingest failing test cases from the incident, add them to the suite, and wire a nightly run against staging. ETA: end of week (Fri).

dmitri: I'll own load tests. Intend to add a burst scenario that reproduces the seq len pattern we saw and baseline 95p/99p token latencies. Need a small infra capacity bump for controlled runs — @kira can you confirm?

kira: Infra can provision a short-lived pool during off-hours. Send the k8s job spec and I'll allocate nodes. :thumbsup:

eva: Prompt sets: I'll curate ~12 prompts from the trace logs and create a label schema (regression vs flake). Suggest running promptset evals on canary once per deploy and nightly on staging.

sam: Chaos drills: propose a tabletop Thursday (30m) + an automated KV eviction experiment in the lab cluster next week. We'll need to update the runbook and add a rollback checklist.

maria: Great. I'll update the board with owners + tentative due dates and create the Thursday invite. Quick sync 11:30 tomorrow to confirm scope? @everyone please add blockers to the doc.

ben: One blocker — we need the exact failing payloads and traces from the incident to seed tests. @sre_team_bot can you attach artifacts?

sre_team_bot: Attached incident artifact: s3://redwood-incidents/2212/incident-2212-kv-eviction/logs.tar.gz

audrey: Oncall already exported the request traces and example prompts. Gist here: https://gist.github.com/abcd — prompt examples and trace snippets are in the gist.

dmitri: Perfect, with those traces I can parameterize JMeter scenarios and simulate sustained bursts.

kira: I'll create a small capacity pool and push kube manifests by EOD. Here's a minimal job snippet I'm expecting (share in thread when ready):
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: load-test-burst
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: jmeter
        image: redwood/jmeter:latest
        args: ["-n", "-t", "burst.jmx"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

maria: Perfect — I'll mark the items in the postmortem and create the calendar events. After the tabletop we'll convert decisions into discrete tickets on the testing board (regression cases, prompt labeling, load scenario, chaos playbook). Thanks all :rocket:

ben: I'll add the failing payloads to the suite once I pull the tarball. ETA Wed morning for the first test commit.

sam: Noted — I'll draft the chaos playbook and share a runbook PR before the tabletop.

audrey: If anyone needs additional trace slices, ping me and I'll export them.

maria: Awesome. Closing loop — action owners: ben/dmitri/eva/sam. Milestones are on the board. See you at 11:30 tomorrow.
